newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Pekao rates Novita as "buy".
newsitem.headline: Polish Pekao rates Novita as "buy".

text.p: Polish CBM Pekao SA brokerage rated carpet maker Novita SA as buy saying the stock was undervalued despite the firm's excellent growth perspectives, Pekao said in a report dated January 29.
The report, released late on Thursday, said the market underrated Novita by valuing it similarily to other textile firms such as garment makers.
"Expected growth of markets (for Novita's products) and the position of the firm on the markets allows to expect significant growth of sales...," the report said.
Novita closed on Thursday at 18.9 zlotys and on January 29, when the report was issued at 13.4 zlotys.
